overclaims: Some requests resolved automatically, and Cruise said human advisors generally supplied wayfinding guidance rather than driving remotely (e1).
The reported assistance figure of “2–4% of the time on average” has no defined denominator.
checks.note: Only the CNBC headline shows 'every four to five miles'. The quoted text never says the cars initiated requests, and nothing in it says some requests resolved automatically. The limitation says 2-4% has no denominator, but the source says 'of the time'. The public excerpt 'remotely assisted (RA) 2-4%' cuts off 'of the time on average, in complex urban environments'. It also doesn't back the 4-5 mile figure the rationale relies on. Event_date 2023-10 doesn't fit a Nov 5 CEO average with no stated period.
